visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The first subject, a muscular man wearing a white baseball cap and a black t-shirt, is interviewed indoors. He stands in front of a white wall with 'TaiNEX 1' signage. His expression is confident as he gestures with his hands while speaking. (2) A fast-paced montage shows the man competing in a sports arena. He is seen pushing a heavy metal sled across a gray concrete floor, his muscles straining and skin glistening with sweat. He is then seen rowing on a machine and eventually lying exhausted on the floor, panting heavily. (3) A second subject, a man in a black and gray camouflage tank top, is interviewed in the same indoor setting. He looks into the camera and speaks with a slight smile. (4) The montage continues, showing the second man also pushing the heavy sled and performing strenuous exercises. He leans over in exhaustion, sweat dripping from his face. (5) Both men are seen together in the final phase, carrying sandbags on their shoulders and running through the arena. They end up standing in front of a large digital scoreboard, looking physically spent but satisfied. The lighting is bright and industrial throughout the venue.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear male voice asks a question in Mandarin. The first respondent answers confidently with a slightly raspy tone. High-energy, upbeat electronic music with a strong kick drum begins immediately. (2) The sounds of heavy, rhythmic breathing and the metallic scraping of a sled on the ground become prominent. The BGM remains steady. A sudden 'ding' sound effect marks a visual transition. (3) A second male voice speaks clearly with a friendly, optimistic tone. Background chatter from the venue is audible but low. (4) Intense grunting and physical exertion sounds are layered over the driving electronic beat. The ambient noise of a large echoey hall is perceptible during pauses in speech. (5) The BGM swells in volume as a crowd cheering sound effect is blended in. The two men speak with strained, breathy voices, reflecting their physical fatigue. The track ends with a sharp cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents two fitness influencers participating in a HYROX competition. It utilizes a before-and-after narrative structure to contrast their initial confident predictions with the grueling physical reality of the race, ultimately highlighting their perseverance and final success.
